description: Design sources for T1 item 1: the generator, its pinned parameter file, the generated RTL, the hand-written streaming wrapper, and the gate-level netlist derived from them. Generator identity: this repository's own rtl/gen at the commit that adds this file (no external generator is pinned); generated output is reproduced by rtl/regen.sh from rtl/params/fft256.params, whose sha256 is in the first lines of each rtl/generated file. The netlist is mapped to sky130_fd_sc_hd at the tt_025C_1v80 liberty corner; the freshness check re-hashes the RTL sources, parameters and netlist against synth/fft256.synth.report.json (cheap mode, no PDK needed, --skip-deck). The full re-run (klt synthesize ... --check ... --rerun) needs Yosys and the PDK and is run locally. Supersedes manifests/item1-inventory-2.json and its attestation manifests/item1-attestation-2.json (recorded evidence, kept unchanged), which hashed rtl/gen/emit.py before issue #197 deduplicated the two complex-multiplier templates' shared arithmetic (the three-product and four-product schedules and both accumulators' rounder connections, 25 byte-identical Verilog lines) into a single _CMUL_CORE string included by both templates: every configuration's generated Verilog stays byte-identical, but the emitter's own content hash moved. The same sources, derived files and checks are carried unchanged.
